messages.title: Ohtia
messages.intro: Your research will be kept in the ohtia folder in your user home.
messages.status_unavailable: The local service is unavailable. Retry or exit.
messages.missing: No research data has been opened or created yet.
messages.located: A saved location awaits compatibility checks. No data has been opened.
messages.pending_create: No research data has been opened or created yet.
messages.locator_invalid: The saved location record is invalid. It has been preserved. Check it before continuing.
messages.locator_newer: The saved location requires a newer application. Use a compatible version.
messages.locator_unreadable: The saved location cannot be read. Check access and retry.
messages.path_rejected: The account’s ohtia folder or saved location cannot be used safely. Existing data is preserved.
messages.startup_failed: Ohtia could not start safely. Check the isolated profile and application files, then retry.
messages.shutdown_uncertain: The local service has not been confirmed stopped. Keep this window open and check the process before exiting.
messages.resource_failure: The application reached its process limit. Close extra windows and retry.
messages.storage_failed: Local data could not be opened. Existing files are preserved. Check access and retry.
messages.recovery_required: A database update needs attention. Retry after inspection or recover the verified checkpoint.
messages.publication_uncertain: The location save is unconfirmed. Data is preserved. Retry to inspect the outcome.
messages.storage_disclosure: Before a schema update, Ohtia keeps a complete local database checkpoint. Recovery may also retain failed files and journals. These copies have the same sensitivity as your data.
messages.save_failed: The save failed. Your input is preserved.
messages.save_uncertain: The save is unconfirmed. Check its receipt before saving again.
messages.refresh_preference: This preference changed in another window. Refresh before saving.
messages.locale_fallback: The saved interface language is invalid. Ohtia is using your system language. The saved value is preserved.
messages.retry_required: The update stopped without a verified checkpoint. Your data is preserved. Retry to inspect the source and continue.
messages.checkpoint_restored: The verified checkpoint has been restored. Data remains closed. Retry to validate and update it before opening.
messages.storage_opening: Opening local data. Please wait; you can exit.
messages.settings.language.title: Language
messages.settings.language.help: Changing the language does not translate documents or change the language of analyses.
messages.settings.language.rejected: Language could not be saved. The previous choice, {value}, is retained.
messages.settings.language.uncertain: It is not yet known whether the language was saved. Its receipt is being checked without sending the change twice.
messages.settings.language.conflict: Another window saved a language meanwhile. That choice is now used.
messages.settings.language.changed: Another window changed the language to {value}.
messages.settings.language.applyFailed: Language saved, but it could not be applied in this window.
messages.settings.language.readFailed: Language could not be loaded. Check the connection and refresh.
messages.settings.language.recovered: No saved change was found after the service recovered. Choose again to make a new change.
messages.command.failed: The action could not be completed. Try again.
messages.about.loadFailed: Version information could not be loaded. Close and reopen this dialog to try again.
messages.about.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the version text and copy it manually.
messages.about.description: A local workspace for academic research.
messages.command.reason.handler_missing: This control is not available in this version.
messages.command.reason.no_edit_target: Focus a text field or select text first.
messages.command.reason.busy: Wait for the current action to finish.
messages.command.reason.last_panel: At least one panel must stay visible.
messages.command.reason.window_limit: Close another window before opening a new one.
messages.help.capabilities: This version opens local data, changes language and appearance, and provides offline help and version details. Research projects and connected analysis are not yet available.
messages.help.language.text: Choose the interface language or use your system language. This does not translate documents or change the language of analyses.
messages.help.appearance.text: Choose system, light or dark appearance for Ohtia windows.
messages.help.zoom.text: Interface zoom changes the size of text and controls. Zoom controls are not available in this version.
messages.help.characters.text: Character presentation controls illustrations. The About illustration is static in this version.
messages.help.layout.text: Workspace layout controls panel visibility and widths. Layout controls are not available in this version.
messages.about.copyOutsideFailed: Copy failed. Open About Ohtia to select and copy the version text manually.
